cases.title: Synthetic +200 m offset cannot become a palaeo reconstruction
cases.scenario: A modern DEM vertical offset is supplied to the same intake surface as an eustatic geological reconstruction.
cases.oracle: Scenario type is immutable and must not be inferred from the numeric offset.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic model-comparison semantics only; no validated palaeogeography, local relative sea level, future coastline or infrastructure feasibility claim.

cases.title: Global eustatic estimate cannot yield local relative sea level with unknown vertical land motion
cases.scenario: A global mean eustatic sea-level value is available but tectonic uplift/subsidence and local vertical reference are unknown.
cases.oracle: Missing local process and datum inputs block local relative sea-level transformation.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic model-comparison semantics only; no validated palaeogeography, local relative sea level, future coastline or infrastructure feasibility claim.

cases.title: Competing palaeo reconstructions preserve original model outputs
cases.scenario: Three independent source records report differing global eustatic estimates for a named age interval.
cases.oracle: Do not average non-commensurable reconstructions or relabel study ranges as a pooled confidence interval.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic model-comparison semantics only; no validated palaeogeography, local relative sea level, future coastline or infrastructure feasibility claim.

cases.title: Shared observations/calibration prevent false independent corroboration
cases.scenario: Two nominal model publications share one upstream proxy dataset and one calibration model.
cases.oracle: Set intersections identify one shared observation and one shared calibration ancestor.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic model-comparison semantics only; no validated palaeogeography, local relative sea level, future coastline or infrastructure feasibility claim.

cases.title: Mismatched age bins block direct pointwise curve comparison
cases.scenario: One curve is reported as a 5 Myr interval mean and another as an age-specific peak with uncertain age.
cases.oracle: Age interval and statistic type are not equivalent without an explicit comparison transform.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic model-comparison semantics only; no validated palaeogeography, local relative sea level, future coastline or infrastructure feasibility claim.

cases.title: Exact synthetic shoreline agreement and disagreement cells
cases.scenario: A five-cell one-dimensional synthetic terrain is tested against two synthetic water offsets; this is only a software oracle.
cases.oracle: Apply the declared <= threshold independently to each model; take set intersection, symmetric difference and invariant dry complement.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic model-comparison semantics only; no validated palaeogeography, local relative sea level, future coastline or infrastructure feasibility claim.

cases.title: Minimax regret across three unweighted geological model families
cases.scenario: Three infrastructure strategies are compared across three equally admissible model forms without assigning probabilities.
cases.oracle: Compute best utility per model, subtract each strategy's utility, then minimize maximum regret; no model probabilities.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic model-comparison semantics only; no validated palaeogeography, local relative sea level, future coastline or infrastructure feasibility claim.

cases.title: Mean or median performance cannot hide a mandatory-floor failure in one model
cases.scenario: A coastal portfolio achieves the highest mean utility but violates a mandatory water/ecological service floor in one model family.
cases.oracle: A strategy is INVARIANT only when every qualified model meets every mandatory floor.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic model-comparison semantics only; no validated palaeogeography, local relative sea level, future coastline or infrastructure feasibility claim.

cases.title: Future supercontinent climate experiment cannot be relabelled as sea-level offset
cases.scenario: A 200/250 Ma climate boundary-condition model is passed to an inundation function expecting sea-level change.
cases.oracle: Climate boundary conditions are not sea-level offset values.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic model-comparison semantics only; no validated palaeogeography, local relative sea level, future coastline or infrastructure feasibility claim.

cases.title: Revised model input creates a new immutable scenario decision record
cases.scenario: The source digest for one reconstruction changes after a decision has been computed.
cases.oracle: A changed source digest changes run identity; historical decision output is immutable.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic model-comparison semantics only; no validated palaeogeography, local relative sea level, future coastline or infrastructure feasibility claim.

cases.title: Adaptive policy cannot observe the future model identity
cases.scenario: A policy chooses a relocation trigger using the hidden model-family label that is revealed only after the simulated decision time.
cases.oracle: Decision inputs must be limited to evidence available at decision time.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic model-comparison semantics only; no validated palaeogeography, local relative sea level, future coastline or infrastructure feasibility claim.

cases.title: Incomplete reconstruction provenance forces UNRESOLVED classification
